title: R&D Senior Member of Technical Staff, Product Development
jobDescription: AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies. Job Title: Senior Software Developer Location: Bangalore, India Employment Type: Full time, regular The job In this role, you will lead the design, development, and deployment of cutting-edge web and cloud applications, work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, and mentor junior developers. This position offers an opportunity to drive impactful technological advancements while contributing to groundbreaking projects. Key Responsibilities Leverage multiple programming languages and tools to design, develop, test, and deploy high-quality web and cloud-based software solutions Engage in architectural design and ensure technical alignment with business objectives and standards Collaborate with diverse technology teams to define and implement robust frameworks and solutions Take a leadership role in release planning, providing input on timelines and guiding junior team members Develop advanced software components adhering to cybersecurity best practices and standards Conduct thorough code reviews, implement unit testing, debug issues, and maintain comprehensive documentation Modernize legacy systems by migrating them to state-of-the-art platforms and technologies. Essential requirements Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent professional experience) 6+ years of hands-on experience in full-stack software development Expertise in building applications using C#, Web API, and RESTful services Strong knowledge of SQL and database technologies Proficiency in Java Script frameworks, including Angular, React and j Query Hands-on experience with cloud technologies like Microsoft Azure Familiarity with serverless architecture and microservices design Proven ability to develop secure, high-performing, and scalable applications Track record of creating robust automated unit and integration tests to ensure code quality Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Dev Ops practices. Desired skills Quick adaptability to new tools, technologies, and evolving requirements. Strong grasp of object-oriented programming, design principles, and reusable design patterns. In-depth understanding of cross-cutting concerns in software architecture. Experience with performance testing tools like JMeter or K6 (preferred). Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, leveraging logical reasoning and pattern recognition. Clear and effective communication skills for technical and non-technical audiences. Familiarity with Agile or SCRUM methodologies for team collaboration. Expertise in front-end technologies like HTML5, CSS3, and Type Script, paired with backend development skills Experience designing secure and reliable frameworks Demonstrated ability to mentor team members and oversee complex projects Strong interpersonal and teamwork skills, with a collaborative mindset R&D at AVEVA Our global team of 2000+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name. Our track record of innovation is no fluke – it’s the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us. You’ll also be joining an award-winning workplace. AVEVA is Great Place to Work® Certified™ in multiple countries, reflecting the culture our people create every day. Explore our awards and recognition. Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/r-and-d-careers/ India Benefits include: Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well-being support It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive. Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/ Hybrid working We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process. Hiring process Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process. Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring-process About AVEVA AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably. We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability-report.aveva.com/ Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/ AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a drug screening and comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria. AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals and minerals – safely, efficiently and more sustainably. jobDescription: AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies. The job Summary We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Consulting Manager – AVEVA Operations Control to lead the design, architecture, and delivery of enterprise-scale Industrial Automation and Digital Transformation solutions using the AVEVA Operations Control portfolio. The ideal candidate will possess extensive expertise in AVEVA Operations Control, AVEVA System Platform, Historian, Operations Management Interface (OMI), Reports, and enterprise industrial system architectures, along with a strong understanding of OT-IT convergence, cloud technologies, cybersecurity, and enterprise integration. The role is responsible for defining scalable, secure, resilient, and high-availability solution architectures while providing technical leadership throughout the entire project lifecycle—from solution consulting and architecture through engineering, deployment, testing, commissioning, and production support. The successful candidate will establish technical standards, drive architecture governance, and ensure solutions align with customer business objectives, industry best practices, and organizational quality standards. In addition to technical leadership, this role includes people management responsibilities, providing mentorship, coaching, and career development for a team of solution architects, technical leads, and engineers. As a trusted technical advisor, the Solution Architect will collaborate closely with customers, business stakeholders, project managers, delivery teams, and cross-functional engineering groups to deliver innovative, reliable, and scalable industrial digital transformation solutions across industries including Oil & Gas, Chemicals, Manufacturing, Mining, Power, Utilities, Water, and Infrastructure. The successful candidate will foster a culture of technical excellence, continuous improvement, innovation, and collaboration while ensuring successful project delivery and customer satisfaction. Key Responsibilities Solution Design & Architecture Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of enterprise-scale Industrial Automation and Digital Transformation solutions using the AVEVA Operations Control portfolio. Define scalable, secure, resilient, and high-availability solution architectures that align with customer business objectives, enterprise IT standards, and OT operational requirements. Prepare, review, and maintain Solution Design Documents (SDD), Functional Design Specifications (FDS), Detailed Design specifications (DDS), Solution architecture, System Architecture, Factory Acceptance Test Procedure, Site Acceptance Test Procedures and deployment documentation. Design and govern deployment architectures for the complete AVEVA Operations Control ecosystem, including: AVEVA System Platform AVEVA Operations Management Interface (OMI) AVEVA Historian AVEVA Identity Manager Galaxy Repository Application Object Servers Alarm Servers Communication Drivers License Manager Microsoft SQL Server IIS Web Servers Architect High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), redundancy, backup, and failover strategies to ensure maximum system availability and business continuity. Lead infrastructure sizing, capacity planning, scalability assessments, and performance optimization for enterprise and mission-critical deployments across on-premises, virtualized, and cloud environments. Define enterprise system architecture, network topology, server infrastructure, cybersecurity controls, communication protocols, and integration patterns, customer standards, and AVEVA best practices. Design secure authentication and authorization solutions leveraging Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, OAuth 2.0, Open ID Connect, HTTPS/TLS, and role-based access control (RBAC). Review and approve technical designs, engineering deliverables, and deployment strategies to ensure architectural consistency, maintainability, and operational excellence. Establish architecture standards, reusable design patterns, implementation guidelines, and technical governance processes across projects. Evaluate new AVEVA product capabilities and emerging technologies to continuously improve solution architecture, standardization, and delivery efficiency. Identify technical risks, perform architecture reviews, and define mitigation strategies to ensure successful project execution. Ensure all solution designs comply with AVEVA recommended practices, cybersecurity requirements, organizational governance, regulatory standards, and project-specific performance, availability, and reliability objectives. Essential requirements Non-Technical: Excellent written, verbal, technical, and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to effectively engage with customers, executive stakeholders, project teams, and multidisciplinary engineering organizations. Strong leadership, mentoring, coaching, and people management skills with experience in developing high-performing technical teams. Proven ability to lead customer workshops, architecture reviews, technical governance meetings, and executive presentations. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and complex technical challenges. Experience in effort estimation, resource planning, risk management, and technical governance across multiple concurrent projects. Willingness and flexibility to travel for customer engagements, architecture workshops, solution reviews, commissioning support, and project delivery activities. Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, Outlook, Power Point, Visio, and Microsoft Project. Technical 18+ years of experience in Industrial Automation, SCADA, MES, or Digital Manufacturing, with at least 10 years in Solution Architecture or Technical Leadership roles. Extensive expertise in the AVEVA Operations Control portfolio, including: AVEVA System Platform AVEVA Operations Management Interface (OMI) AVEVA Historian AVEVA Identity Manager AVEVA Communication Drivers AVEVA License Manager Proven experience architecting and delivering enterprise-scale AVEVA Operations Control solutions for mission-critical industrial environments. Strong expertise in designing scalable, secure, resilient, and highly available industrial architectures for on-premises, virtualized, cloud, and hybrid environments. Extensive experience in enterprise architecture, infrastructure sizing, capacity planning, redundancy, disaster recovery (DR), failover strategies, and system performance optimization. Strong knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server, IIS, Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and enterprise authentication and authorization mechanisms. Experience designing secure architectures utilizing HTTPS/TLS, OAuth 2.0, Open ID Connect (OIDC), Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and cybersecurity best practices Strong understanding of OT/IT convergence and enterprise integration with systems such as SAP, IBM Maximo, Microsoft applications, RESTful APIs, OPC DA/UA, MQTT, and other industrial communication protocols. Experience designing enterprise data architectures involving AVEVA Historian, SQL Server, reporting platforms, and analytics solutions. Strong understanding of cloud platforms, particularly Microsoft Azure, including Virtual Machines, networking, storage, identity management, and hybrid deployment architectures. Experience establishing architecture standards, engineering guidelines, reusable frameworks, and governance processes across multiple projects. Proven ability to perform technical reviews, solution validation, architecture governance, and design assurance throughout the project lifecycle. Strong knowledge of Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), commissioning, production deployment, operational readiness, and support transition. Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams through the complete project lifecycle, from solution consulting and architecture to implementation, commissioning, and production support. Experience with AVEVA CONNECT, Industrial Io T, Digital Transformation initiatives, and cloud-based industrial solutions is desirable. Knowledge of enterprise integration patterns, microservices architecture, containerization, and Dev Ops practices is considered an advantage. Experience mentoring Solution Architects, Technical Leads, and Engineers while fostering technical excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement within engineering organizations. Services at AVEVA Our dynamic global team of 700+ engineers, developers, consultants, solution architects and project managers are at the forefront of delivering AVEVA cutting-edge solutions to customers. Job Title: IT Oracle Fusion Test Engineer Location: Hyderabad Employment Type: Full-time, regular, hybrid work arrangements The job We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced IT Oracle Fusion Test Engineer to join our established Oracle Co E. This role will support the Finance organization in the successful delivery of both project initiatives and operational enhancements across the Oracle ecosystem. As a key member of the Oracle Co E Testing team, you will contribute throughout the end-to-end project lifecycle, ensuring that solutions meet business, functional, and quality expectations before deployment. In addition to supporting testing activities, you will collaborate with the broader QA community to drive testing best practices, continuous improvement initiatives, and the overall maturity of quality assurance processes. Key responsibilities Plan, design, execute, and support testing activities across Oracle Fusion Cloud applications. Perform comprehensive manual testing, including: Smoke Testing Sanity Testing Functional Testing System Integration Testing (SIT) Regression Testing Data Migration Testing User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Analyse business and functional requirements to develop effective test scenarios, test cases, and validation strategies. Execute end-to-end testing to ensure business processes function as designed across integrated Oracle applications. Hands-on experience with Azure Dev Ops (ADO) for test management, execution tracking, defect management, and reporting. Manage end-to-end testing activities using Azure Dev Ops (ADO), including the creation, maintenance, execution, and tracking of test cases, test suites, and test plans to ensure complete test coverage and requirements traceability. Maintain testing governance and reporting within ADO by documenting test results, defects, risks, and quality metrics, while ensuring accurate linkage of requirements, test artefacts, defects, and deployment activities throughout the testing lifecycle. Strong understanding of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), defect lifecycle management, and requirements traceability. Identify, document, track, and manage defects through to resolution, collaborating closely with development and functional teams. Support release validation activities and provide quality sign-off recommendations based on testing outcomes. Contribute to the development and adoption of QA standards, methodologies, and best practices. Participate in project planning, requirement reviews, risk assessments, and test strategy discussions. Essential requirements 3 to 5 years of experience in Software Testing or Quality Assurance. Strong functional testing experience with Oracle Fusion Applications. Proven ability to perform comprehensive end-to-end validation across Oracle Fusion business processes. Solid understanding of the Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and defect management processes. Experience in requirement analysis, test planning, test case design, execution, and reporting. Proficiency in defect lifecycle management, including logging, prioritization, tracking, retesting, and closure. Strong knowledge of integration testing and validation across multiple business processes and systems. Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with business and technical stakeholders. Desired skills Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with excellent attention to detail. Ability to work collaboratively with developers, business analysts, project managers, and business users. Experience working within global teams comprising both onshore and offshore resources. Ability to provide accurate and proactive status reporting to project and management stakeholders. Self-motivated, proactive, and committed to continuous learning and process improvement. Demonstrated passion for enhancing testing methodologies, quality standards, and overall solution quality. Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively. This positions the role as an Oracle Fusion functional tester who not only performs end-to-end testing but also owns test governance, documentation, traceability, and execution management through Azure Dev Ops, which is a key expectation in modern QA team for the Oracle Co E. jobDescription: AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies. Job Title: R&D Member of Technical Staff II, Cloud Operations & Infrastructure Location: Bangalore Employment Type: Full-time Work Mode: Hybrid work arrangement At AVEVA, we’re all about limitless possibilities. Are you? As part of the Research and Development function, the global Cloud Operations & Infrastructure team combines software development and cloud operations to provide continuous integration and delivery of cloud-enabled products and solutions, along with continuous monitoring to ensure various cloud-specific customer requirements/SLAs are met. As a Cloud Operations Engineer you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and implementing advanced cloud-based applications and services. Your work will focus on pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in cloud computing, exploring new technologies, and developing innovative solutions that align with the company’s strategic goals. Working closely with your development and portfolio colleagues, together you will bring new solutions to the cloud following a standard framework to ensure they are operationally secure, stable and scalable. The global, 24x7 nature of the team means there may be a requirement for occasional work outside of the standard day and to be on call as part of a shared team rota. Key responsibilities Work on modern approaches to software development including the ability to develop microservices and leverage serverless functions. Work with development teams to advise and contribute to improvements to operational stability, security, cost management and reporting requirements for our cloud solutions. Continually develop and improve Dev Ops processes, adding value through optimization, automation, and effective reporting. Provide timely and effective response to incidents to minimize the impact on our customers and keep colleagues updated as required. Oversee relevant Cloud deployments to ensure successful implementation, track and report progress, resolve or escalate release issues. Proactively manage cloud environments to minimize service impacting issues, including infrastructure as code, certificates, storage, health status, backup status etc. Ensure new services meet required operational readiness standards before being accepted into operations. Ensure on-going compliance to security practices and policies. Provide subject matter expertise to business stakeholders as required. Maintain clear and accurate operational documentation. Stay current on security industry trends, tools and best practices. Essential requirements The following list applies to Azure and/or AWS Platforms. At least 4 years of experience in software development and / or Dev Ops/SRE, with at least 3 years of focus on Cloud environments. Strong programming skills, e.g. C#, .NET Core or Java. Knowledge of Power Shell or Node JS or Python scripting. Proficient in containerization technologies like Docker or Kubernetes. Knowledge of API, REST, microservices, serverless architecture. Knowledge of Cloud Authentication protocols such as OAuth, Identity Servers, Open ID Connect and SAML etc… Knowledge of Azure administration, Azure APIs, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, APIO Management, Service Bus, Event Grids, Storage Accounts and Key Vaults and tools. Or, equivalent AWS experience. Knowledge and experience of operational support, software development and deployment methodologies and principles. Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, able to convey information clearly and concisely to technical and non-technical audiences. Attention to detail, diligent and tenacious. Excellent analysis and dissemination skills. High degree of personal motivation and ability to self-manage. Maintains and develops relevant industry and technology knowledge. Desired skills and competencies Certifications in Azure and/or AWS. Hands-on experience working within an Information Security accredited framework e.g. ISO27001, 27017/18. Experience working in Agile software development such as Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe). AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name. jobDescription: AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies. Job Title: Sr. Data Platform Engineer – Azure & Microsoft Fabric Location: Mumbai Employment Type: Full Time, regular, hybrid work arrangement The Job We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and analytics solutions on Microsoft Fabric. This role is central to our ongoing migration from Azure Synapse Analytics to Microsoft Fabric, and you will play a key part in shaping our modern data platform built on the Medallion Architecture. The ideal candidate combines strong ETL/ELT engineering skills with hands-on experience integrating diverse API sources, a solid understanding of downstream analytics needs (Power BI, data profiling, and analysis), and the ability to support light Dev Ops activities. The role is structured as approximately 90% data engineering and 10% Dev Ops, so while your primary focus will be building and optimizing data pipelines, you will also help with pipeline deployment, environment management, and release coordination. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain robust data pipelines in Microsoft Fabric (Data Factory pipelines, Dataflows, Notebooks) to ingest, transform, and load data at scale. Implement and maintain a Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold layers) within One Lake, ensuring data quality, consistency, and reliability at each stage. Build and manage ETL/ELT processes to extract data from a variety of source systems, including REST/SOAP APIs, databases, files, and third-party services, landing data into Data Factory / One Lake. Lead and support the migration of existing Azure Synapse Analytics workloads (pipelines, dataflows, SQL pools) to Microsoft Fabric, ensuring minimal disruption and data integrity throughout. Write and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and views for data transformation, validation, and reporting. Perform data profiling and data quality assessments to identify anomalies, inconsistencies, and gaps in source and transformed data. Collaborate with BI developers and analysts to ensure data models support efficient Power BI reporting and dashboarding. Partner with business and technical stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into scalable data engineering solutions. Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize pipeline performance, ensuring reliability and cost efficiency. Support light Dev Ops activities (~10% of role) such as CI/CD deployment of pipelines, environment/version management in Azure Dev Ops or Git, and basic release coordination for Fabric artifacts. Document data flows, architecture decisions, and pipeline logic for maintainability and knowledge sharing. Apply data governance, security, and compliance best practices across the data platform. Essential Requirements 5–8 years of experience in data engineering roles, with a strong ETL/ELT background. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, including Data Factory pipelines and One Lake. Solid, demonstrable experience with Azure Synapse Analytics — prior involvement in a Synapse-to-Fabric migration is a strong plus. Strong understanding and practical implementation experience of Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold layers). Advanced SQL skills — query optimization, stored procedures, complex joins, and performance tuning. Experience integrating and consuming APIs (REST/SOAP) as data sources within pipeline development. Working knowledge of Power BI — data modeling, DAX basics, and report/dashboard support. Experience with data profiling and data quality validation techniques. Familiarity with version control (Git) and basic CI/CD practices for data pipelines (e.g., Azure Dev Ops). Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data patterns and identify issues. Good understanding of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modelling, and data lake architectures. Excellent communication skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams. Desired Skills Experience with Python or Py Spark for data transformation in Fabric Notebooks. Exposure to Azure Dev Ops for pipeline deployment and orchestration beyond basic CI/CD. Knowledge of Microsoft Purview or other data governance/cataloging tools. Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer, Azure Data Engineer Associate). Job Title: Director – MES Practice Lead (Global Delivery Center India) Job Family: Services Delivery / Digital Manufacturing (MES) Location: Global Delivery Center (GDC) Reporting: Reports to GDC Leadership; strong matrix alignment with Regional MES Practice Lead Purpose Lead and scale the MES Services business for the Global Delivery Center by building a strong MES competency, driving delivery excellence, and improving margins through standardization and templatization. This role partners closely with the regional counterpart to support growth, shape pipeline, and ensure successful execution for existing and new customers—while applying a strong people-first leadership approach. Key Responsibilities Practice & Business Leadership Own the GDC MES practice roadmap aligned with global/regional MES strategy. Define and manage the practice operating model: engagement, delivery readiness, resourcing, capability growth, and knowledge management. Partner with regional MES leaders to align offerings, priorities, and execution approach. Program Leadership (Leading from the Front) Lead large and complex MES programs “from the front” with strong ownership of outcomes, stakeholder alignment, and execution rigor. Set the bar for execution excellence across program management, solution delivery, and customer communication. Delivery Excellence & Governance Establish and enforce project governance across MES programs (scope, schedule, risk, quality, and stakeholder management). Ensure consistent delivery standards, templates, and quality gates across all projects. Provide leadership for escalations, enable corrective actions, and institutionalize lessons learned. Standardization, Templatization & Margin Improvement Build and maintain reusable assets (delivery playbooks, templates, accelerators, estimation models, reference architectures). Drive productivity and margin improvements by increasing reuse and reducing delivery variability. Track and improve practice KPIs (margin, utilization, schedule predictability, quality, CSAT). MES Competency Development (Capability Building) Develop MES techno-functional capability across architecture, configuration, integration, testing, deployment, and hyper care. Define skill matrices, learning paths, certifications, mentoring plans, and succession pipeline. Establish communities of practice and continuous improvement mechanisms across delivery teams. People Leadership (People First) Lead, coach, and mentor practice leaders, project managers, architects, and delivery teams. Build a high-performing culture with strong engagement, accountability, and career growth. Drive performance management, talent development, and retention initiatives. Customer Engagement & Pipeline Growth Engage with existing customers to strengthen relationships, improve satisfaction, and expand scope/footprint. Support pre-sales with discovery workshops, solution shaping, proposals, estimations, risk reviews, and delivery strategy. Drive pipeline growth in partnership with sales and regional MES leadership. Qualifications / Experience Minimum 15+ years of experience in MES Services, including end-to-end delivery ownership and services leadership. Proven experience leading large MES programs from the front (multi-site / multi-geography programs preferred), including go-live leadership and executive stakeholder management. Strong MES techno-functional expertise with end-to-end delivery ownership. Demonstrated success in improving margins via standardization, templatization, and governance. Strong executive stakeholder management, communication, and customer-facing leadership. Track record of building and scaling competencies, teams, and delivery leaders. Critical Skills Excellent people management and coaching capability; strong “people-first” mindset. Practice leadership: operating model, governance, metrics, delivery excellence. Business acumen: profitability/margins, utilization, productivity, pipeline contribution. Collaboration: strong partnership with regional counterpart and cross-functional teams. Customer engagement: credibility to lead workshops, escalations, and value discussions. Preferred Qualifications AVEVA platform experience preferred, with demonstrated exposure to delivering MES solutions leveraging AVEVA technologies (e.g., AVEVA MES / related AVEVA digital manufacturing ecosystem). Strong MES competency/bench with clear career paths and reduced key-person dependency. Increased pipeline and expanded customer footprint through proactive engagement. High team engagement, retention, and leadership bench strength. jobDescription:
AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies. Job Title: AI Principal Technologist, Dev
- AI Core Services Development Location: Bangalore Employment Type: Regular, Full-Time Reports To: AI Senior Manager We are looking for passionate and skilled Software Developers to join our Core AI Services team. In this role, you will help design, develop, and scale AI-enabling platform services and public APIs that are secure, reliable, and cloud-native. These services will act as foundational building blocks for AI adoption across AVEVA’s product portfolio and partner ecosystem. You will part of a Scrum team to build innovative, standards-compliant, secure and production-grade AI capabilities, with a builder mindset
- rapid prototyping and continuous improvement with agility of a start-up. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Build scalable, fault-tolerant cloud-native services on Microsoft Azure, ensuring high performance and reliability. Develop secure, well-documented public APIs and SDKs for consumption by internal and external developers. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver end-to-end solutions across data pipelines, orchestration, and service APIs. Embed robust security controls to protect sensitive data and ensure secure access to AI services. Contribute to design reviews, code reviews, and architectural discussions to ensure engineering excellence. Mentor junior developers, encourage continuous learning, and contribute to a culture of innovation. Work with multiple teams to create AI solutions, which include AI model deployment, training, and AI tooling development. AI & Cloud Expertise Experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs) and understanding of trade-offs between performance, cost, and capability. Understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agent orchestration, prompt engineering, and tool calling. Experience with AI standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent2Agent (A2A). Strong knowledge or experience in working with various ML algorithms (regression, classification, clustering, deep learning) Knowledge of AI ethics and regulations (e.g., NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act), and commitment to responsible AI development. Fluent in developing code using AI Tools such as Git Hub Copilot. Must be able to use prompt engineering to carry out multiple development tasks. Familiar with AI orchestration, including tools like AI Foundry and/or Semantic Kernel, MAF. Experience with tools for automated testing and evaluation of AI outputs is a plus. Core Skills and

QUALIFICATIONS:
8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3+ years working directly on AI/ML systems or platforms. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and associated Paa S services (e.g., Azure Functions, AKS, API Management). Strong expertise in RESTful API design, versioning, testing, and lifecycle management. Proficient in securing APIs, managing authentication/authorization and data privacy practices. Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyse complex technical challenges and propose scalable solutions. title: Sales Data Quality Analyst
jobDescription: AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies. Job Title: Sales Data Quality Analyst Location: Bangalore or Hyderabad India Employment Type: Full-time, regular, hybrid work arrangement About the job Seeking dynamic and detail-oriented Sales Data Quality Analysts to join our team. Analysts will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and integrity of sales deal data, focusing on critical elements that impact business decisions and financial outcomes. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to validate, maintain, and enhance the quality of sales data, thereby enabling informed decision-making and driving business growth. Key Responsibilities Conduct thorough data profiling and analysis to identify data anomalies, inconsistencies, and outliers. Execute comprehensive data quality checks to ensure accuracy and completeness of critical data elements including but not limited to conversion rates, new/renewal splits, incremental Annual Contract Value (ACV) / Total Contract Value (TCV), and deal spans. Develop and implement data cleansing and standardization processes to ensure consistency and accuracy across sales deal data. Validate the classification of new logos and account segments to ensure alignment with organizational criteria and strategies. Conduct thorough reviews of closed lost renewal deals to verify alignment with new business opportunities and prevent discrepancies in deal categorization. Ensure accuracy and completeness of SPIF attributes and flags associated with sales deals. Perform validation checks on opportunity close dates and start dates to ensure timely renewal validation and compliance with contractual terms. - on budget delivery of optimization applications while meeting customer requirements, review of process drawings and data, configuration and testing of open-equation process models, automation of model applications and commissioning on-line process models at customer site Build various Real Time Optimization, Reconciliation and Economic models using in-house process industry tools such as APO, APA & AUSC Analysis of technical requirements, model building and troubleshooting, perform economic and technical sensitivities that help in product enhancement and client requirement Develops and maintains expert level knowledge of refining, petrochemical and upstream production process requirements, features and application of optimization technologies. Job Title: R&D Principal Technologist, Product Development Location: Bangalore Employment Type: Regular, full-time, hybrid work arrangement The Job At AVEVA, we’re looking for an experienced R&D Principal Technologist to join the Predictive Analytics product team. This is a senior, hands-on technical leadership role focused on designing and evolving enterprise software that works with large-scale industrial and time-series datasets, delivers advanced analytics, and provides rich web-based user experiences. The role requires strong full-stack engineering expertise across C#/.NET and modern Java Script/Type Script technologies, including Angular, combined with experience building scalable, high-performance applications that process and present large volumes of data. You will provide technical direction across the product lifecycle, lead complex feature development and architectural decisions, and collaborate with Product Management, Architecture, QA, Dev Ops, and other R&D teams. You will operate at both the strategic and hands-on engineering levels—shaping technical direction while remaining close to the code. Key Responsibilities Define and evolve the architecture and technical direction for Predictive Analytics, with a focus on scalability, performance, security, maintainability, and modernization. Lead the design and hands-on development of complex features spanning C#/.NET backend services, APIs, data processing, and Angular-based user interfaces. Design solutions capable of efficiently handling large-scale datasets and high-volume time-series data. Drive performance engineering across the data, backend/API, and UI layers, applying techniques such as query optimization, caching, pagination, asynchronous processing, batching, and efficient data transfer. Design and evolve distributed and cloud-connected solutions using appropriate patterns including microservices, event-driven architecture, asynchronous messaging, resiliency patterns, and Domain-Driven Design (DDD). Drive product modernization and evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and architectural approaches through technical discovery and proof-of-concepts. Champion engineering excellence through strong practices in software design, code quality, automated testing, security, observability, and CI/CD. Lead technically complex initiatives, identify and mitigate technical risks, and coordinate dependencies across teams and shared platforms. Partner with Product Owners and R&D leadership on backlog shaping, estimation, technical roadmaps, and delivery planning. Mentor and coach engineers, promote knowledge sharing, and raise the technical capability of the broader engineering team. Contribute to production readiness, performance diagnostics, troubleshooting, release risk assessment, and continuous improvement. Essential Requirements Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 10+ years of professional software development experience delivering enterprise software products. Strong hands-on experience with C#/.NET, including enterprise applications, APIs, and services. Strong experience with Java Script/Type Script and Angular for modern enterprise web application development. Proven full-stack development experience across backend, frontend, APIs, and supporting services. Strong experience designing applications that process large-scale datasets, with an understanding of data access performance, scalability, memory utilization, and efficient data processing. Strong understanding of object-oriented design, design patterns, clean architecture, API design, and distributed systems. Experience designing scalable and resilient systems using concepts such as microservices, asynchronous/event-driven architectures, and fault-tolerance patterns. Working knowledge of cloud-native application development, including Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, and service-based deployment architectures. Strong understanding of modern engineering practices including automated testing, Git, CI/CD, Azure Dev Ops, secure development, and observability. Demonstrated technical leadership, with the ability to lead complex initiatives, influence technical decisions, and mentor engineers. Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Desired Skills & Experience Experience building data-intensive, analytics-driven, or time-series applications where data volume, processing performance, and UI responsiveness are critical. Experience optimizing performance across data access, APIs, backend processing, caching, and frontend rendering. Experience working with on-premises, cloud, and hybrid architectures. Familiarity with Azure services and technologies such as Azure Service Bus, Azure Key Vault, AKS, and related cloud services. Experience with modern authentication and authorization patterns such as OIDC and JWT. Experience modernizing monolithic enterprise applications toward modern .NET, Angular, microservices, and cloud-native architectures. Strong understanding of software security, dependency management, vulnerability remediation, and secure development lifecycle practices. Experience with technical discovery, prototyping, and evaluating architectural and technology trade-offs. Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tools such as Git Hub Copilot and their responsible use for development, testing, documentation, and developer productivity. Experience with industrial analytics, process data, historian platforms, time-series data, or other data-intensive industrial software is an advantage. Experience working with geographically distributed Agile/Scrum product development teams. jobDescription: AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies. Job Title: Oracle Fusion Controls and System Analyst Location: Hyderabad Employment Type: Full time, Hybrid The job We are seeking an Oracle Fusion Controls and System Analyst to support access management, controls compliance, and configuration governance across AVEVA's enterprise platforms, including Oracle Fusion, Tax, EPCM, and other business-critical applications. The role will be responsible for user access administration, role governance, SOX/PCAOB controls testing, audit evidence management, and oversight of configuration changes within regulated environments. Working closely with business stakeholders, system owners, auditors, and support teams, you will help ensure that access and configuration activities are secure, compliant, well-documented, and audit ready. Key responsibilities Manage user access provisioning, modifications, role assignments, and access removals across Oracle Fusion, Tax, EPCM, and related enterprise systems. Support Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML) processes and periodic access reviews. Perform controls testing and maintain audit evidence to support SOX, PCAOB, and internal compliance requirements. Review and validate access and configuration changes to ensure appropriate approvals, documentation, and governance standards are met. Maintain accurate audit trails for access and configuration activities to support internal and external audits. Monitor and support remediation of access-related incidents, audit findings, and control deficiencies. Coordinate with global business and technical teams to ensure consistent application of access and configuration governance processes. Perform post-implementation validation of security and configuration changes. Identify opportunities for automation, process improvement, and enhanced compliance reporting. Automate periodic activities. Escalate security, compliance, or governance risks as required. Essential requirements Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. 2+ years of experience in access and system governance. Experience in ERP access management, security administration, controls compliance, or system governance. Understanding of SOX, ITGC controls, and audit processes. Knowledge of Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Segregation of Duties (So D), and access governance. Experience preparing audit evidence and supporting compliance reviews. Strong stakeholder management, documentation, and analytical skills. Desired skills Familiarity with GRC and access governance tools. Exposure to Service Now or other ITSM platforms. Understanding of automation technologies such as Power Automate, Power BI, or workflow automation solutions. Knowledge of configuration governance and change management processes across multiple environments. title: Oracle Fusion Technical Support Consultant
jobDescription:
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Technical Support Consultant to join our Global Shared Services Centre (SSC) in Hyderabad. Our Oracle Fusion landscape supports 40+ countries across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM, making this a high‑impact global support position. The primary responsibility is to support and maintain existing Oracle Fusion technical components, including templates, reports, integrations, e‑invoicing processes, and interface frameworks. In addition to day‑to‑day support, the role will also work on small change requests and may participate in larger global projects as needed. Key responsibilities
1. Global Technical Support & Issue Resolution (Primary Focus) Deliver L2/L3 technical support for Oracle Fusion across 40+ countries and multiple time zones. Troubleshoot issues related to: BI Publisher, OTBI Reports & FRS BICC FBDI/HCM/financial interface errors REST & SOAP API integrations UCM file transfers and staging table exceptions Investigate and resolve regional localization issues (tax, statutory fields, formats). Provide root‑cause analysis and implement sustainable fixes. Knowledge of Sandbox creation, Webservices, exposure to Groovy Script.
2. Template Maintenance & Localization Support, modify, and enhance BI Publisher templates across: GL, AP, AR, FA, CM Procurement PPM Subscriptions RMCS Ensure templates meet: Global standards Local statutory requirements Branding, language, and formatting conventions
3. E‑Invoicing Support (Multi‑Region) Support e‑invoicing processes across APAC, EMEA, LATAM, and North America. Troubleshoot schema validations, rejections, data extraction issues, and statutory updates. Work with regional Finance and Tax teams for compliance and legislative changes.
4. Integration Support (Mule Soft Collaboration) Act as the Oracle Fusion technical liaison for all Mule Soft integrations. Support Oracle-side integration components: REST/SOAP service enablement FBDI inbound processes BI Publisher extracts UCM interfaces Help troubleshoot cross‑system issues using payloads, logs, and error reports. Support testing for integration changes and enhancements.
5. Reports Support & Enhancements Maintain and troubleshoot: OTBI reports BI Publisher reports & data models Financial Reporting Studio (FRS) reports Optimise report performance and ensure accuracy across global regions.
6. Support for Small Change Requests Deliver minor enhancements to existing: Templates Reports Data models FBDI integrations API configurations BICC PVO Enhancements Participate in scoping, technical impact analysis, and documentation. Ensure changes are fully tested and deployed following standard change control.
7. Participation in Larger Projects (as needed) Assist in requirements gathering, technical design, testing, or cutover tasks. Support global rollouts, new country onboarding, or module enhancements. Contribute technical inputs for integration, reporting, and data conversion activities.
8. Quarterly Patch Support Perform technical impact assessment after each Oracle Cloud quarterly update. Run regression testing and fix patch‑related defects. Coordinate with global stakeholders on any changes impacting technical components. title: R&D Member of Technical Staff - II, Technical Writing
jobDescription:
AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies. Job Title: R&D Member of Technical Staff
- II, Technical Writing Location: Bengaluru, India – Hybrid Employment Type: Full-time regular (flexible working options available) The job As part of our global technical writing group, you’ll collaborate with one or more teams of skilled software engineers from our global research & development group in writing and publishing technical documentation and associated content for our products and solutions. You’ll help us research and transform complex technical concepts, specifications, and procedures into user-oriented information for non-technical and technical audiences for developing high-quality software documentation that meets user needs. Key responsibilities
- Learn complex work from self-learning, training, and shadowing seniors
- Work under minimal supervision on advanced, unstructured, and complex work
- Improve the quality of content, adhere to the established standards and guidelines, and deliver on time
- Design, develop, review, and publish high-quality technical documentation Essential requirements
- Experience in working with products and solutions in industrial software
- Experience in working with global agile and Dev Ops teams
- Experience in working with Author-it Cloud and Microsoft Azure Desired skills and competencies
- Master’s or bachelor's degree in English, Computer Science, or Engineering
- 3-5 years of experience in technical writing and documentation development
- Knowledge of software product development and cloud computing services
- Competent at concepts, processes, and tools of technical writing and information development

jobDescription: AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies. Job Title: R&D Principal Technologist Location: Bangalore Employment Type: Regular, full-time, hybrid work arrangement The job R&D Principal Technologist is a senior technology leader responsible for driving Dev Ops, cloud, platform engineering, and reliability strategies across the organization. The role requires 10+ years of experience in software engineering, cloud infrastructure, SRE, or related areas, with expertise in CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, Kubernetes, cloud-native architectures, Dev Sec Ops, observability, and automation. The individual will architect scalable, secure, and resilient solutions across Azure, AWS, and hybrid environments while leading cross-functional teams, mentoring engineers, and influencing technical strategy. Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills are essential to deliver platform modernization, engineering excellence, and measurable business outcomes. Key responsibilities Lead the strategic evolution of CONNECT Dev Ops platform capabilities, partnering with engineering, product management, architecture, and business stakeholders to accelerate delivery of critical programs and enterprise initiatives. Define and drive the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for cloud-native Dev Ops platforms, ensuring scalability, reliability, security, and operational excellence across the organization. Champion Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and Platform Engineering practices to proactively improve system availability, performance, resilience, and operational efficiency. Provide technical leadership and architectural governance across software delivery, infrastructure automation, CI/CD, deployment models, observability, and cloud operations. Drive the design and implementation of highly scalable, secure, and compliant CI/CD ecosystems that enable continuous delivery and accelerate product release velocity. Drive observability strategies through enterprise monitoring, distributed tracing, telemetry, logging, and AIOps solutions to enhance operational intelligence and predictive incident management. Lead the development of advanced automation, self-healing, auto-remediation, and intelligent operational tooling to minimize downtime, improve service reliability, and reduce manual intervention. Establish governance and best practices for Infrastructure-as-Code, configuration management, cloud resource optimization, and deployment automation across enterprise-scale environments. Influence organizational Dev Ops maturity by defining metrics, KPIs, and engineering excellence initiatives focused on reliability, deployment efficiency, platform adoption, and operational effectiveness. Serve as the technical authority and trusted advisor for Dev Ops architecture, cloud infrastructure, platform modernization, and software delivery transformation initiatives across CONNECT. Essential requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, Dev Ops, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), with experience leading enterprise-scale initiatives. Proven track record in defining and driving Dev Ops strategy, cloud adoption, platform modernization, and engineering excellence across multiple teams. Expert understanding of CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code (Ia C), cloud-native architectures, containers, Kubernetes, Dev Sec Ops and observability platforms. Strong software development and automation expertise with proficiency in languages such as Python, Power Shell, C#, Go, or similar technologies. Demonstrated ability to architect scalable, secure, highly available, and resilient solutions across Azure, AWS, and hybrid-cloud environments. Strong leadership, mentoring, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence technical direction across engineering organizations. Excellent communication skills with the ability to present complex technical concepts to senior leadership, architects, engineers, and business stakeholders. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, drive strategic technology decisions, and deliver measurable business outcomes. Desired skills and competencies Expert knowledge of Azure Dev Ops, Git Hub, Git, CI/CD pipeline design, and software delivery automation. Deep expertise in Azure and/or AWS cloud platforms, Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, ARM, Bicep, Cloud Formation), and cloud governance. Extensive experience with Kubernetes, container platforms, and modern platform engineering practices. Strong experience in observability, monitoring, logging, automated remediation, and reliability engineering. Advanced scripting and automation skills using Power Shell, Python, Bash, or equivalent technologies. Knowledge of enterprise security, identity management, compliance, and Dev Sec Ops best practices. Relevant certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Dev Ops Engineer Expert, AWS Professional, or Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) are highly desirable. Experience in Azure Service Fabric is an added advantage. This role is based in Madrid and is expected to work collaboratively with the local Data Science and AI team as part of normal hybrid working. The successful candidate will begin with a short induction period within the Cloud Operations team, followed by an embed period, working directly with the Data Science & AI team. During this phase, day‑to‑day priorities will be guided by the Data Science and AI team with a focus on establishing reliable, production‑grade data pipelines, hardening platform operations, and ensuring alignment to Cloud Ops standards for security, reliability, and cost efficiency. The role will provide direct support for AI for ALL delivery priorities. After this embed period, the role will transition into the standard Cloud Operations operating model. This role is ideal for a pragmatic engineer who thrives on making platforms dependable—improving environments, hardening pipelines, automating deployments, and resolving operational issues quickly. It is highly delivery‑oriented and requires close collaboration across Cloud Ops, security/governance, and analytics teams to ensure AVEVA’s data and AI capabilities run securely, efficiently, and at scale. Key responsibilities Databricks platform engineering (Azure): Build, configure, and operate Databricks workspaces, clusters, policies, and supporting Azure services. Production readiness: Enable a clear path to production environments, including operational processes, runbooks, incident response practices, and release readiness. Pipeline reliability: Support and harden ETL/ELT pipelines (e.g., Delta Lake patterns), job orchestration, and workload performance tuning. Automation & CI/CD: Implement infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD practices for Databricks and related Azure resources (e.g., Terraform/Bicep, Azure Dev Ops/Git Hub). Security & access: Implement least-privilege access, secrets management, identity integration, auditability, and compliance-aligned controls (in partnership with Security / Governance). Observability & operations: Improve logging, monitoring, and cost controls; diagnose and resolve platform/network issues affecting delivery. Embedded delivery support: Participate in Madrid-based team stand-ups and planning; manage an agreed backlog of tasks that unblock AI for ALL and analytics delivery. Essential requirements Azure & Databricks expertise: Strong hands-on experience operating Azure Databricks in enterprise settings; able to troubleshoot workspace, networking, and performance issues. Engineering discipline: Comfortable with automation, CI/CD, Ia C, and operational best practices. Data platform fundamentals: Working knowledge of Spark, Delta Lake, Python and SQL; ability to partner effectively with data engineers, AI engineers and data scientists. Operational mindset: Bias to reliability and delivery; able to triage issues quickly and communicate clearly across distributed teams. Stakeholder collaboration: Works effectively across time zones and teams; able to translate requirements into actionable platform work. 5+ years experience in cloud/platform engineering (preferably Azure) 2+ years hands-on experience with Databricks (Azure Databricks strongly preferred). Candidates who do not meet the required years of experience may still be considered if they possess the following certifications: AZ-900 (Azure Fundamentals) AZ-305 (Designing Azure Infra Solutions) AZ-104, AZ-400 (Dev Ops Focused) and/or AI-102 (AI) will be advantageous Experience with networking/security patterns in Azure (VNETs, private endpoints, Key Vault, managed identities, etc.). Experience with Ia C (Terraform, ARM/Bicep) and CI/CD for platform and data workloads. Desired skills Familiarity with AWS/GCP concepts Experience with Unity Catalog Experience supporting data governance patterns and lineage/metadata tooling Familiarity with Gen AI workload considerations. IT at AVEVA Our global team of 300+ IT professionals is responsible for the systems and platforms that keep AVEVA running. By empowering our colleagues and ensuring the smooth operation of the company, we help keep the business healthy and productivity high. We also provide key support for the transformation and modernisation efforts globally. We pride ourselves on a collaborative, inclusive and authentic culture that provides a framework allowing for autonomy, whilst always being available for support and guidance. We respect the differences that each team member brings and seek to include those perspectives in our solutions for our business functions. The energy and sense of purpose is evident when talking to team members, you will feel part of something special from the first day you join. Find out more: https://www.aveva.com/en/about/careers/ India Benefits include: Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well-being support It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive. Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/ Hybrid working We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process. Hiring process Interested? Great! jobDescription: requirements, partner with R&D to deliver high-quality outcomes, and ensure the voice of the customer is embedded into every phase of product development. This role requires strong technical fluency and comfort operating in an agile delivery environment. You will represent the voice of the user in engineering forums, drive clarity through well-formed requirements and acceptance criteria, and create transparency into prioritization decisions and delivery progress. As a senior individual contributor, you will demonstrate strong product management craft, influence without authority, and operational excellence. You will help raise the bar on how product decisions are made—using customer evidence, market insight, and data-driven metrics to guide prioritization and trade-offs. In this role, you will also play a critical part in stakeholder engagement— responding to customer issues that impact product success. Success requires strong communication, comfort navigating ambiguity, and the ability to drive alignment across teams toward shared outcomes. Main responsibilities Product Execution & Delivery Opportunity Definition: Prepare and manage Opportunity Canvases and related Initiatives, defining objectives, value propositions, success measures, priorities, and delivery scope in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders. Backlog Ownership: Own the product backlog for your scope: intake, triage, refinement, prioritization, and readiness for development. Requirements & Scenarios: Translate user needs and cross-product scenarios into clear requirements (user stories, functional and non-functional requirements, acceptance criteria) that R&D can implement. Delivery Planning: Partner with R&D to define milestones, sequencing, and release plans; proactively manage risks, dependencies, and scope trade-offs. Technical Reviews: Participate in technical and development reviews; provide product input on implementation decisions to ensure usability, supportability, security, and scalability. Release Readiness: Drive product release strategy and readiness by coordinating engineering, documentation, support, services, marketing, and enablement activities. Internal Engagements: Represent the product in internal forums to provide clarity, alignment, and decision support across teams. Issue Resolution: Coordinate responses to escalated customer-facing or internal issues impacting product success; drive root-cause understanding and prioritization of fixes. description: requirements, partner with R&D to deliver high-quality outcomes, and ensure the voice of the customer is embedded into every phase of product development. This role requires strong technical fluency and comfort operating in an agile delivery environment. You will represent the voice of the user in engineering forums, drive clarity through well-formed requirements and acceptance criteria, and create transparency into prioritization decisions and delivery progress. As a senior individual contributor, you will demonstrate strong product management craft, influence without authority, and operational excellence. You will help raise the bar on how product decisions are made—using customer evidence, market insight, and data-driven metrics to guide prioritization and trade-offs. In this role, you will also play a critical part in stakeholder engagement— responding to customer issues that impact product success. Success requires strong communication, comfort navigating ambiguity, and the ability to drive alignment across teams toward shared outcomes. Main responsibilities Product Execution & Delivery Opportunity Definition: Prepare and manage Opportunity Canvases and related Initiatives, defining objectives, value propositions, success measures, priorities, and delivery scope in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders. Backlog Ownership: Own the product backlog for your scope: intake, triage, refinement, prioritization, and readiness for development. Requirements & Scenarios: Translate user needs and cross-product scenarios into clear requirements (user stories, functional and non-functional requirements, acceptance criteria) that R&D can implement. Delivery Planning: Partner with R&D to define milestones, sequencing, and release plans; proactively manage risks, dependencies, and scope trade-offs. Technical Reviews: Participate in technical and development reviews; provide product input on implementation decisions to ensure usability, supportability, security, and scalability. Release Readiness: Drive product release strategy and readiness by coordinating engineering, documentation, support, services, marketing, and enablement activities. Outcome Validation: Ensure high-quality outcomes by defining success criteria, validating solutions (customer/field feedback), and driving iteration. Customer & Internal Engagement Voice of the Customer: Serve as the trusted voice of the customer—ensuring product decisions are grounded in real user problems and that customer feedback is systematically incorporated. Internal Engagements: Represent the product in internal forums to provide clarity, alignment, and decision support across teams. Issue Resolution: Coordinate responses to escalated customer-facing or internal issues impacting product success; drive root-cause understanding and prioritization of fixes. Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement Portfolio Strategy Translation: Work closely with the Portfolio Director to understand portfolio strategy and investment priorities for the assigned area, and translate them into clear long-term direction and short-/mid-term execution plans (roadmap, sequencing, and quarterly objectives) aligned to delivery capacity and customer outcomes. Cross-Team Alignment: Collaborate with key stakeholders, including Portfolio/Product leadership, R&D, UX, Customer Success, Support, and other internal groups to align product initiatives with company and product strategies. Stakeholder Communication: Clearly present product strategy, roadmap, scope decisions, and progress updates to internal stakeholders; ensure shared understanding of goals, trade-offs, and timelines. Team Development & Operational Excellence Operating Cadence: Establish and maintain strong product operating practices (e.g., roadmap reviews, backlog refinement, discovery cadence, release readiness) to enable predictable execution. Collaboration & Leadership: Lead through influence—aligning engineering, UX, and cross-functional stakeholders around shared outcomes. Quality & Responsiveness: Ensure high standards for product quality, usability, and customer impact; ensure responsiveness to user feedback via the feedback portal and other vehicles. Skills Product Management Excellence & Strategic Execution Ability to write high-quality requirements and acceptance criteria; comfortable decomposing ambiguous problems into executable increments. Experience collaborating day-to-day with engineering teams in agile development environments; confident in development reviews and backlog grooming. End-to-End Product Ownership: Demonstrated success owning products across discovery, delivery, launch, and iteration. Prioritization & Trade-Offs: Ability to manage competing priorities while balancing short-term and long-term investments. Outcome Orientation: Strong focus on measurable customer value and business impact (not just output). Cross-Functional Execution: Proven ability to work effectively with engineering, UX, marketing, sales, and customer success. Customer & Market Focus Customer-Centric Mindset: Consistent practice of grounding decisions in customer needs and usage evidence. Communication & Influence Clear Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to communicate roadmap, decisions, and trade-offs. Stakeholder Management: Ability to align diverse stakeholders and handle disagreement constructively. Storytelling: Ability to articulate value and rationale to different audiences. Technical & Analytical Skills Data-Driven Decision Making: Ability to use metrics, analytics, and qualitative insights to guide decisions. Technical Fluency: Solid understanding of software development and product delivery practices; able to collaborate effectively with R&D. Product Lifecycle Understanding: Familiarity with ideation, MVP delivery, iteration, customer feedback loops, and end-of-life considerations. Execution & Operational Excellence Organizational Skills: Strong planning and execution discipline; reliable follow-through. Continuous Improvement: Ability to inspect-and-adapt product practices to improve delivery, adoption, and customer outcomes. Qualifications Typically 5+ years of product management experience; candidates with 3+ years may be considered depending on scope and demonstrated technical execution strength. Experience in industrial software, data/analytics platforms, or enterprise Saa S preferred. Customer support, customer success, services, or field experience with the PI System suite of products (or similar) is preferred. jobDescription: Key Responsibilities Serve as the first point of contact for technical support requests from global customers via phone, email, and ticketing systems. Provide strong technical expertise in Cloud Applications, Licensing, Networking, and Hosting technologies, along with AVEVA industrial software solutions such as AVEVA E3D, AVEVA P&ID, AVEVA Diagrams, AVEVA Unified Engineering on CONNECT, AVEVA System Platform, In Touch OMI, AVEVA PI System, AVEVA Asset Information Management (AIM), and AVEVA NET. Deliver L1 and L2 technical support for the above AVEVA products, including user assistance, issue triage, root cause analysis, and resolution or escalation as required. Monitor and respond to automated alerts, performing corrective actions or escalating as per defined procedures. Manage support queues, ensuring timely resolution and proactive communication with customers. Collaborate with regional and global teams for effective escalation and resolution of product- and platform-related issues. Work closely with fulfillment teams to address AVEVA licensing concerns, activations, renewals, and updates. Partner with product development teams on upcoming releases and known issues to ensure seamless implementation and customer readiness. Deliver support aligned with industry best practices and AVEVA support standards. Document operational procedures and create knowledge base articles related to AVEVA products, cloud services, and common customer issues for continuous improvement. Contribute to process optimization and service excellence initiatives within the support organization. Functional Competencies Proven experience in a technical support environment, preferably in a global setting. Hands-on exposure to supporting industrial software or engineering applications, preferably AVEVA products such as E3D, P&ID, System Platform, In Touch OMI, PI System, or CONNECT-based services. Strong troubleshooting skills for network, OS, and server-related issues. Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) with the ability to manage conflict constructively. Familiarity with alert monitoring tools (e.g., Sentinel) and issue tracking systems (preferably Service Cloud). Ability to handle customer calls and interactions professionally across time zones. Knowledge of IT service management practices and frameworks. Good understanding of Cloud technologies (AWS, Azure) and disaster recovery concepts. Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to multitask under minimal supervision. Positive, proactive attitude with a commitment to continuous improvement. Education BE / B.Tech or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field. Key Working Relationships AVEVA Support teams (local and global) Regional management and service delivery managers Customers’ technical representatives using AVEVA engineering and operational systems Product development, testing, and implementation teams Experience 3 to 5 years of relevant experience Knowledge, Skills & Experience Required Hands-on experience with Cloud-based applications and related technologies. Experience supporting engineering, Monitoring control , operations, or asset management software, preferably within the AVEVA product ecosystem. Broad knowledge of IT client support including Operating Systems, TCP/IP, DNS, and web-based technologies. Strong understanding of PC configuration, VPN, and Firewall. jobDescription: Job Description Job Title: Principal Consultant Location: Hyderabad Employment Type: Full Time The job We are seeking a highly accomplished and experienced Principal Consultant – Unified Operations Center (UOC) to lead the architecture, strategy, and delivery of enterprise-scale Industrial Automation and Digital Transformation solutions using the AVEVA portfolio. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in AVEVA System Platform, Unified Operations Center (UOC), industrial system architectures, SCADA/HMI solutions, enterprise integration, cloud-enabled industrial platforms, and OT-IT convergence. The Principal Consultant will be responsible for defining enterprise solution blueprints, establishing architecture and engineering standards, leading technical governance, and ensuring the successful delivery of scalable, secure, resilient, and high-availability solutions across complex industrial environments. As a trusted advisor to customers and executive stakeholders, the Principal Consultant will collaborate with business leaders, enterprise architects, project managers, and multidisciplinary engineering teams to shape digital transformation initiatives across industries including Oil & Gas, Chemicals, Manufacturing, Mining, Utilities, Water, and Power. The role also includes driving pre-sales and solution consulting activities, mentoring senior consultants and engineering teams, establishing technical best practices and reusable frameworks, and influencing the organization's technology roadmap while ensuring successful project execution and long-term customer success. Key Responsibilities Solution Design & Architecture Lead the architecture, design, and technical governance of enterprise-scale Unified Operations Center (UOC) and Industrial Automation solutions using the AVEVA portfolio. Define enterprise solution blueprints, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps aligned with customer business objectives and digital transformation strategies. Own the preparation, review, and approval of High-Level Design (HLD), Low-Level Design (LLD), Solution Design Documents (SDD), and architecture standards. Define and govern deployment architectures across the AVEVA ecosystem, including: Galaxy Repository Application Object Servers AVEVA Historian Communication Drivers AVEVA OMI Alarm Servers Application Servers License Manager Identity Manager Establish architecture standards, engineering best practices, reusable frameworks, and governance models to ensure consistency across multiple projects and delivery teams. Design and review High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), redundancy, failover, backup, and business continuity strategies for mission-critical industrial applications. Lead infrastructure sizing, capacity planning, scalability assessments, and performance optimization for enterprise and multi-site deployments. Define enterprise system architectures encompassing network topology, virtualization, cloud/hybrid deployments, cybersecurity, identity management, and OT-IT integration. Provide technical leadership in solution reviews, architecture governance, risk assessments, and design assurance to ensure compliance with customer standards, AVEVA best practices, and industry regulations. Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend architecture improvements to enhance system scalability, reliability, maintainability, and operational efficiency. Collaborate with customer stakeholders, enterprise architects, and multidisciplinary engineering teams to develop innovative, future-ready solutions that meet both business and operational objectives. Serve as the technical authority for complex solution design decisions, architecture escalations, and strategic technology direction across multiple projects and customer engagements.
