Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with the ability to manage complex technical and business challenges. Ability and flexibility to travel for customer engagements, solution workshops, architecture reviews, commissioning, and project delivery. Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, Power Point, Outlook, and Microsoft Project. Technical 12–18 years of experience in Industrial Automation, SCADA, and Digital Transformation, with extensive hands-on experience delivering enterprise-scale solutions using the AVEVA portfolio. Recognized subject matter expert in the AVEVA product suite, including System Platform, Operations Control (UOC), OMI, Historian, Communication Drivers, Reports, Application Server, License Manager, and Identity Manager. Extensive experience in defining enterprise architecture, solution blueprints, and deployment strategies for large-scale AVEVA System Platform implementations. Proven experience leading Unified Operations Center (UOC) / AVEVA Operations Control programs across multiple sites, business units, or geographically distributed facilities. Strong expertise in designing highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient industrial automation architectures, including redundancy, disaster recovery (DR), and failover strategies. Extensive experience in AVEVA System Platform object modeling, template development, standardization, governance, and reusable engineering frameworks. Strong knowledge of AVEVA System Platform scripting, .NET Framework integration, I/O mapping, and device integration. Hands-on experience developing high-performance HMI applications, dashboards, and visualizations using AVEVA OMI, Archestr A Graphics, and In Touch. Strong understanding of industrial communication protocols, including OPC DA, OPC UA, MQTT, and enterprise integration patterns. Extensive experience integrating AVEVA System Platform with enterprise applications such as SAP, MES, ERP systems, SQL Server, REST APIs, and other business applications. Strong knowledge of relational database design, SQL Server, data integration, and industrial data management. Experience with SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) and enterprise reporting solutions is desirable. Proven experience in solution sizing, infrastructure planning, system capacity assessment, and performance optimization for enterprise deployments. Strong understanding of distributed system architecture, client/server optimization, load balancing, virtualization, redundancy, and high-availability deployments. Experience with cloud-enabled industrial solutions, including AVEVA CONNECT, Microsoft Azure, hybrid architectures, and OT-IT convergence is highly desirable. Proven experience leading technical governance, architecture reviews, design approvals, and engineering quality assurance across multiple projects. Strong experience in defining and executing Factory Acceptance Test (FAT), Site Acceptance Test (SAT), commissioning, and production rollout strategies. Demonstrated ability to lead end-to-end project delivery, from requirements gathering and solution architecture through development, testing, commissioning, production deployment, and customer handover. Experience contributing to pre-sales activities, including solution proposals, effort estimation, technical presentations, proof-of-concepts (Po Cs), and customer demonstrations. Working knowledge of industrial cybersecurity principles, secure system design, identity management, and network architecture is highly desirable. Experience mentoring senior engineers and consultants, establishing engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and technical best practices across the organization. Strong attention to detail, with experience maintaining accurate system data, records, and audit-ready documentation. Ability to follow established processes and controls, understand dependencies, perform basic issue analysis, and escalate appropriately. Understanding of GDPR and responsible handling of sensitive employee data. Strong customer service, written communication, and stakeholder management skills. jobDescription: Key responsibilities Make high-impact technical decisions and trade-offs across scalability, reliability, performance, maintainability, and business needs. Design, develop, test, debug, and maintain software across new features and existing codebases (including unfamiliar areas with minimal guidance). Mentor and unblock others—coach junior engineers, guide peers, and resolve roadblocks efficiently by engaging the right collaborators. Essential requirements Bachelor’s/master’s in computer science/engineering (or equivalent practical experience). 7+ years of hands-on full-stack experience building enterprise web applications (C#/.NET + Java Script/UI +j Query). Strong experience building APIs using C#, Web API, and REST patterns. Demonstrated end-to-end ownership delivering medium-to-high complexity features (design → build → test → release/support). Strong engineering fundamentals: clean, maintainable architecture, and well-tested code. Strong debugging/problem-solving across UI, API, and data layers. Working knowledge of quality practices (unit/integration/UI tests, code reviews, regression discipline). Practical experience with CI/CD and Dev Ops practices (pipelines, release basics, environment awareness). Strong front-end architecture skills—modular design, state management, reusable components, and maintainable patterns across a growing codebase. Proven quality-first UI/API delivery—test strategy (unit/integration/UI automation), regression control, and effective code reviews that raise code quality and reduce defects. Ability to lead a medium-sized initiative end to end independently —break down work, estimate, coordinate dependencies, and drive delivery outcomes across UI + API. Familiarity with secure-by-design in web apps—auth flows, secure client-side patterns, dependency hygiene, and vulnerability remediation basics. Experience mentoring junior engineers and contributing to backlog refinement/estimation. Preferred skills Experience developing industrial/process data visualization products (e.g., historian/SCADA-style platforms). Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Git Hub Copilot) and responsible usage in engineering workflows. Knowledge of the PI System domain: PI Vision, PI AF, PI Data Archive (data modelling, time-series concepts, typical user workflows). to End Integration Exp.
